name: desktop-control
title_zh: 不看屏幕也能看见桌面的盲操手
tagline_zh: 窗口列表、控件文字、坐标全变成 JSON——没视觉接口也能点、打、按热键。OCR 兜底。
tagline_en: Windows UI Automation or OCR turns every control into JSON with coordinates—click, type, hotkey, and paste tables.
desc_en: See and drive the user's desktop without vision - list and focus windows, read on-screen controls and text as JSON with coordinates (UI Automation on Windows, OCR elsewhere), then click, type, send hotkeys, open apps and paste tables into Excel/SPSS/GraphPad Prism/Zotero.
why_zh: 把『看见』降维成结构化数据，让无头 Agent 第一次拥有桌面级操作精度。坐标即真相。
why_en: Reduces 'seeing' to structured JSON—coordinates are ground truth, OCR only a fallback. Gives headless agents desktop-grade.
limit_zh: 只认 Windows 原生 UI Automation；跨平台靠 OCR，但坐标误差±5px，点不准细按钮。
limit_en: Native UI Automation on Windows only; OCR elsewhere has ±5px error—misses tiny buttons. Target apps must be installed and foregrounded; won't wait.
title_en: Drive your desktop blind: see UI as JSON, act without vision
